stylePrompt: Use the declared styleFamily for each item and choose subjects from people, communities, animals, plants, landscapes, weather, tools, vehicles, buildings and everyday objects according to the scene. Keep one coherent style inside each image while varying styles across the batch. Shared constraints: mature learner-facing art direction, landscape 3:2 composition, a clear focal action or relationship, no in-image teaching text, and no live-action or realistic-human impression. When people appear, every readable foreground or midground face must have clearly rendered natural eyes, a nose, a mouth and a scene-appropriate expression. Never use blank oval faces, featureless masks, mannequin heads or shadows that erase the facial features. Vary age, skin tone, facial structure, body type, hairstyle, clothing, ability and occupation naturally. No realistic skin pores, photographic faces, stock-photo staging, logos, watermarks, readable interfaces, chibi proportions or glossy toy rendering.

items.sentenceEn: The horse may shy at the sudden rustle of a tarp.
items.sentenceZh: 帆布突然沙沙作响时，马可能会受惊避开。
items.scene: In a safe open paddock, a calm horse reacts to a lightweight tarp fluttering unexpectedly by stepping sideways away from it; a handler holds a loose lead at a safe distance, not pulling or hitting. Show the horse's startled avoidance, not a timid human personality. Accurate equine anatomy, no panic injury, text or logos.
items.altText: 马听到帆布突然发出声响后侧身避开，牵马人保持安全距离。

items.sentenceEn: The contract includes a clause about delivery dates.
items.sentenceZh: 合同中有一项关于交货日期的条款。
items.scene: At a contemporary Chinese tea cooperative, two adult trading partners review a blank pictorial supply contract; one distinct boxed section is highlighted with a tea-crate icon moving toward a blank calendar icon, showing a single delivery-timing clause within a larger agreement. Natural faces and hands, no readable writing, numbers, real legal seals or logos.
items.altText: 中国茶叶合作社的双方查看合同中单独框出的交货时间条款。

items.sentenceEn: The volunteers picked up trash along the river path.
items.sentenceZh: 志愿者们沿河边步道捡拾垃圾。
items.scene: In a contemporary Chinese riverside park, adult volunteers wearing ordinary gloves and using grabbers collect scattered wrappers and empty cups from the path into plain waste bags; the cleaned section contrasts with a small remaining littered section. Respectful natural faces, safe handling, no city slogan, writing, logos or national flags.
items.altText: 中国河滨步道上，志愿者把散落的垃圾装入垃圾袋。

items.sentenceEn: The officer presented a warrant before the search.
items.sentenceZh: 搜查前，执法人员先出示了授权令状。
items.scene: At a fictional home threshold, a calm uniformed officer presents a neutral formally sealed blank authorization document to an adult resident before any search begins; a closed door and waiting team make the order of events clear. No forced entry, weapon, assumed guilt, readable text, real jurisdiction marks or logos. Complete natural faces and hands.
items.altText: 执法人员站在门外，搜查前先向住户出示授权令状。

items.meaningZh: 残废的；有缺陷的；失效的
items.sentenceEn: Disabled visitors can use the new step-free entrance.
items.sentenceZh: 残障访客可以使用新建的无障碍入口。
items.scene: At a contemporary Chinese public library, an adult wheelchair user independently follows a broad step-free entrance beside a small staircase, with an accessible door opening at the same main entry; other visitors use both routes naturally. Center access and autonomy rather than pity. Natural adult faces and hands, accurate wheelchair geometry, no labels, stereotypes, text or logos.
items.altText: 中国公共图书馆入口设置无台阶通道，轮椅使用者可自主进入。

items.sentenceEn: The tribunal listened to both sides of the dispute.
items.sentenceZh: 裁判所听取了争议双方的陈述。
items.scene: A fictional independent three-member tribunal sits at a modest elevated hearing table, listening equally to two parties seated at balanced tables on opposite sides; the dispute remains unresolved, with blank case folders. No gavels or uniforms from a real country, verdict, readable writing, real symbols or logos. Natural diverse adult faces and hands.
items.altText: 中立裁判席上的成员平等听取争议双方的陈述。

items.sentenceEn: Gross pay is the total before deductions.
items.sentenceZh: 工资总额是扣除各项费用之前的总数。
items.scene: A large complete stack of plain pay tokens sits on the left; a small portion is then removed into a separate deductions tray, leaving a smaller take-home stack on the right. Make the original gross total distinct from the after-deduction result, without specific tax claims. No currency symbols, percentages, text, labels, numbers, people or logos.
items.altText: 完整工资总额先呈现，再扣去一部分，余下较少的实领金额。

items.sentenceEn: The prosecutor chose to prosecute the case in court.
items.sentenceZh: 检察官决定在法庭上起诉此案。
items.scene: In a fictional neutral courtroom, a prosecutor stands with a blank case folder and presents the case to a judge while a defense representative is also present; the proceeding is just beginning and no verdict appears. Focus on bringing a legal case forward, not guilt or punishment. Natural complete adult faces and hands, no real court seal, writing or logos.
items.altText: 检察官在中立法庭上提出案件，辩方也在场，尚无裁决。

items.sentenceEn: The committee voted to amend the park rules.
items.sentenceZh: 委员会投票决定修订公园规则。
items.scene: At a contemporary Chinese community park meeting, adult committee members compare a simple old pictorial park-rule board with a revised version; one leaf-shaped icon is visibly replaced and hands are raised in a calm vote. Convey revision of an existing rule, not creation from scratch. No political signs, real government marks, readable writing, text or logos; natural faces and hands.
items.altText: 中国社区会议上，成员投票将旧公园规则板的一项内容改成新版。

items.sentenceEn: He muttered 'damn' when he dropped his keys in a puddle.
items.sentenceZh: 钥匙掉进水坑时，他低声咒骂了一句。
items.scene: An adult standing safely on a sidewalk sees his keys plop into a shallow rain puddle and reacts with a brief frustrated expression and small blank speech puff; a tiny splash shows the mishap. Keep it mild and humorous, not angry violence. Complete illustrated face and natural hands, no written swear, readable text, logos or injury.
items.altText: 钥匙掉进浅水坑，男子露出懊恼神情并低声咕哝。

items.sentenceEn: A neutral expert will arbitrate the contract dispute.
items.sentenceZh: 一名中立专家将仲裁这场合同争议。
items.scene: At a neutral table, an independent adult expert examines matching blank contract folders from two disagreeing business parties seated at equal distance and calmly prepares a balanced determination; a central set of simple balanced scales symbolizes impartiality. No courtroom verdict, conflict escalation, readable text, real seals or logos. Fully drawn faces and hands.
items.altText: 中立专家坐在争议双方之间，审看材料并准备作出公断。

items.meaningZh: 荷尔蒙；激素(旧称荷尔蒙)
items.sentenceEn: A hormone carries a signal from one part of the body to another.
items.sentenceZh: 激素把信号从身体的一处传递到另一处。
items.scene: An abstract but biologically sensible cutaway human torso shows one small endocrine gland releasing distinctive molecule-like messenger shapes into a blood vessel; they travel to a distant target tissue whose matching receptors receive them. Focus on chemical signaling rather than nerves, with no medical claims or detailed treatment. No labels, letters, numbers, text or realistic exposed anatomy.
items.altText: 内分泌腺释放激素信号，经血液到达远处组织并与受体结合。

items.sentenceEn: The court set bail so the accused could await trial outside detention.
items.sentenceZh: 法院设定保释条件，让被告在审判前暂时离开拘押场所。
items.scene: In a fictional legal setting, an adult accused person leaves a simple holding area through an open gate after a neutral court representative places a plain assurance token into a court tray; a distant future hearing room remains ahead. Show conditional pretrial release, not acquittal or guilt. No prison bars around the person, handcuffs, real seals, writing or logos; natural face and hands.
items.altText: 法院设定保释条件后，被告在审判前暂时离开拘押区。

items.meaningZh: (织物的)密度；(材料等的)结构；纹理
items.sentenceEn: The two bowls have different surface textures.
items.sentenceZh: 这两只碗的表面纹理不同。
items.scene: In a contemporary Chinese ceramics workshop, an adult potter gently touches two handmade bowls side by side: one has clearly rough unglazed raised grain, the other a smooth glossy glaze. Close-up surface detail and fingertips make tactile texture the focus, with fully illustrated face and natural hands. No signs, text, logos or brand marks.
items.altText: 中国陶艺师触摸两只表面不同的碗，一只粗糙、一只光滑。

items.sentenceEn: The council issued a decree protecting the old forest.
items.sentenceZh: 委员会颁布了一项保护古老森林的法令。
items.scene: A fictional local council formally issues a blank sealed order document bearing only a tree emblem; from the document a protective boundary around an old forest is shown in an inset landscape. Emphasize formal authoritative issuance, not a casual suggestion. No real country, political party, flags, readable writing, numbers or logos. Complete adult faces and hands.
items.altText: 虚构委员会正式颁布保护老森林的法令文件。

items.sentenceEn: The officers detain the person briefly while checking the report.
items.sentenceZh: 执法人员在核查报告期间暂时留住此人。
items.scene: In a fictional neutral public building, two calm officers ask an adult person to wait in a seated area while another officer checks a blank case folder nearby; a visible hourglass suggests a temporary hold. No physical force, restraints, guilt, criminal stereotype, weapon, writing, real badges or logos. All natural adult faces and hands.
items.altText: 执法人员核查资料时，请一人暂时在等候区停留。

items.meaningZh: 铅笔；色笔；眉笔；画笔；光线束
items.sentenceEn: She sketched the flower with a sharp pencil.
items.sentenceZh: 她用削尖的铅笔画下这朵花。
items.scene: In a contemporary Chinese art classroom, an adult student draws the outline of a real flower with one clearly visible sharpened graphite pencil on blank paper; the pencil point and emerging sketch are the clear focus. Natural complete face and hand, no writing, labels, text or logos.
items.altText: 中国美术课堂里，学生用削尖的铅笔勾画一朵花。

items.sentenceEn: The person remained in detention while the case was reviewed.
items.sentenceZh: 案件审查期间，此人仍被拘留。
items.scene: A fictional neutral detention facility interior shows an adult person seated calmly in a humane supervised room while a separate transparent inset shows a reviewer examining a blank case folder; a closed access door conveys ongoing custody, with no trial outcome. No dehumanizing cage, handcuffs, violence, guilt implication, writing, real symbols or logos. Complete natural faces and hands.
items.altText: 案件仍在审查时，当事人在有人监督的拘留场所等待。

items.sentenceEn: The explorers reached the frontier of the mapped region.
items.sentenceZh: 探险者们抵达了地图已标区域的边缘。
items.scene: A small team of adult explorers stands at the edge of a known mapped landscape where a clear surveyed trail and detailed map fade into an unsurveyed open valley beyond; the frontier is the boundary between known and unexplored, not a national border. No weapons, colonial imagery, flags, place names, readable text or logos. Natural faces and hands.
items.altText: 探险队走到地图已标地区的边缘，前方是尚未勘察的山谷。

items.sentenceEn: The panel voted to indict the suspect after reviewing the evidence.
items.sentenceZh: 审查小组审看证据后，投票决定正式指控嫌疑人。
items.scene: In a fictional neutral review room, an independent panel examines blank evidence folders and votes to issue one formal charging document; a separate adult suspect and counsel are shown only in a distant side panel, with no trial or verdict. Distinguish formal accusation from prosecution and conviction. No real legal insignia, restraints, readable writing, names, text or logos. Natural faces and hands.
items.altText: 审查小组查看材料后投票发出正式指控文件，案件尚未审判。
